S04.meta: // SLIDE 04 — SPROUTING MACHINE: Normal Notch-controlled sprouting vs VEGF-flooded tumor

tracks.label: Normal angiogenesis
tracks.outcome: Ordered tube: one tip cell leads, stalk cells form lumen
notes: One endothelial cell selected as tip cell
Notch suppresses tip-cell identity in neighbors
Stalk cells elongate and form a patent tube

tracks.label: Tumor angiogenesis
tracks.outcome: Chaotic tangle: multiple tip cells, leaky non-perfused vessels
notes: Multiple cells simultaneously adopt tip-cell identity
No single leader — branching without coordination

S07.meta: // SLIDE 07 — ANGIOGENIC SWITCH: Will a dormant micrometastasis vascularize?

branches.label: Anti-angiogenic factors dominate
branches.detail: Thrombospondin-1, endostatin (cleaved from collagen 18), angiostatin hold the balance
branches.fix: Tumor stays below 1–2 mm; oxygen diffusion limit enforces dormancy

branches.label: Pro-angiogenic factors tip the balance
branches.detail: VEGF, FGF, PDGF, angiopoietin-2 accumulate; thrombospondin-1 suppressed
branches.fix: Angiogenic switch flips; tumor recruits vessels and resumes exponential growth

resolver.label: Late recurrence — dormant micrometastasis whose angiogenic switch finally flipped
resolver.detail: A cancer returning ten years after the primary was removed is often a dormant micrometastasis that lost anti-angiogenic suppression, not a new primary

S09.meta: // SLIDE 09 — VASCULAR NORMALIZATION: What does anti-VEGF therapy actually do to vessels?

data.question: What happens when you block VEGF in a tumor?

branches.label: Predicted: vascular starvation
branches.detail: Cut blood supply → tumor starves → complete response
branches.fix: Vasculature collapses uniformly; cancer cells die from hypoxia and nutrient deprivation

branches.label: Observed: normalization window
branches.detail: Most aberrant, hyperpermeable vessels collapse first; remaining network is pruned toward more normal architecture
branches.fix: Reduced interstitial pressure → improved drug delivery; window is time-limited before re-pruning overshoots

resolver.label: Rakesh Jain's normalization window
resolver.detail: At moderate doses and short durations, VEGF blockade selectively eliminates the most aberrant vessels — creating a window of improved perfusion and chemotherapy co-delivery, not simple starvation
